# Core prevalence plots

The fast step. Reads the small CSVs written by `02_core_prevalence_compute.Rmd` and makes the core lists, recovery gain tables, and sensitivity plots. Nothing here touches the big recovery CSV.

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
#install.packages("paletteer")
library(paletteer)
```

## Parameters

These drive the calculations before the plots (core lists, recovery gain, core counts). Plot settings live in each plot chunk. `gate_ih_min` has to be in the computed `gate_cuts`, `recov_ih_min` has to be in `recov_cuts`, and recovery can't be higher than the gate.

```{r params}
gate_ih_min  <- 20                               # gate used for the core lists and recovery gain
recov_ih_min <- 1                                # recovery threshold used for the core lists and recovery gain
min_freq     <- 0.90                             # prevalence cutoff for "core"
freq_cuts    <- c(0.80, 0.85, 0.90, 0.95, 0.999) # prevalence cutoffs for core counts and the plots

plural <- c(species = "species", genus = "genera")
in_dir <- "./core_prevalence"

### Update User
cat(sprintf("Core:  >= %.1f%% prevalence at gate %d, recovery %d\n", min_freq * 100, gate_ih_min, recov_ih_min))
cat("Sensitivity cutoffs:", paste(freq_cuts, collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

## 1. Load the prevalence files

```{r load}
grid_file   <- file.path(in_dir, "prevalence_grid.csv")
params_file <- file.path(in_dir, "run_params.csv")

### Check: prevalence files exist
if (!all(file.exists(grid_file, params_file))) {
  stop('Files not found in "', in_dir, '". Run 02_core_prevalence_compute.Rmd first.')
}

prevalence_grid <- read_csv(grid_file, show_col_types = FALSE,
                            col_types = cols(taxon = "c", n_present = "i", freq = "d",
                                             gate_ih = "i", recov_ih = "i",
                                             level = "c", method = "c"))
run_params <- read_csv(params_file, col_types = cols(.default = "c"))

n_srr      <- as.integer(run_params$n_srr)
levels     <- str_split_1(run_params$levels, ";")
gate_cuts  <- sort(unique(prevalence_grid$gate_ih))
recov_cuts <- sort(unique(na.omit(prevalence_grid$recov_ih)))

### Check: chosen gate and recovery were computed, and recovery <= gate
stopifnot(gate_ih_min %in% gate_cuts, recov_ih_min %in% recov_cuts, recov_ih_min <= gate_ih_min)

### Update User
cat(format(nrow(prevalence_grid), big.mark = ","), "rows in prevalence_grid, computed", run_params$computed, "\n")
cat(sprintf("Computed with gate_min_srr %s, %d metagenomes\n", run_params$gate_min_srr, n_srr))
cat("Gates available:   ", paste(gate_cuts, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Recovery available:", paste(recov_cuts, collapse = ", "), "\n")

### Check: build CSV unchanged since the compute step
src <- run_params$source_file
if (file.exists(src) && format(file.mtime(src), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") != run_params$source_mtime) {
  cat("WARNING: the build CSV has changed since these were computed. Rerun 02_core_prevalence_compute.Rmd.\n")
} else {
  cat("Prevalence files match the current build CSV\n")
}
```

## 2. Core at the chosen gate and recovery

```{r core}
by_level <- map(levels, \(l) filter(prevalence_grid, gate_ih == gate_ih_min, recov_ih == recov_ih_min,
                                    method == "recovered", level == l)) %>%
  set_names(levels)
core <- map(by_level, \(d) filter(d, freq >= min_freq))
```

## 3. Recovery gain

Recovered at the chosen gate and recovery, compared with strict-only at the same gate. A full join keeps taxa found only by strict-only, so negative gains show up too. Those come from genomes that meet the gate in fewer than `gate_min_srr` metagenomes: strict-only counts them, but they aren't eligible for recovery.

```{r recovery-gain}
strict_by_level <- map(levels, \(l) filter(prevalence_grid, gate_ih == gate_ih_min,
                                           method == "strict only", level == l)) %>%
  set_names(levels)

gain_at <- function(l) {
  full_join(by_level[[l]]        %>% select(taxon, freq_recovered = freq),
            strict_by_level[[l]] %>% select(taxon, freq_strict    = freq),
            by = "taxon") %>%
    mutate(across(c(freq_recovered, freq_strict), \(x) replace_na(x, 0)),
           gain = freq_recovered - freq_strict) %>%
    arrange(desc(gain))
}

gains <- map(levels, gain_at) %>% set_names(levels)

### Update User
for (l in levels) {
  g <- gains[[l]]
  cat(sprintf("\n%s: %d gained, %d unchanged, %d lost (median gain %.2f)\n",
              l, sum(g$gain > 0), sum(g$gain == 0), sum(g$gain < 0), median(g$gain)))
  cat("Top 10 gains\n")
  print(head(g, 10))
}
```

## 4. Core counts

`series` labels each column: "recov 1", "recov 3", and so on for the recovered method, and "strict only".

```{r core-counts}
series_levels <- c(paste("recov", recov_cuts), "strict only")

core_counts <- prevalence_grid %>%
  crossing(min_freq = freq_cuts) %>%
  summarize(n_core = sum(freq >= min_freq), .by = c(level, method, gate_ih, recov_ih, min_freq)) %>%
  mutate(series = factor(if_else(method == "strict only", "strict only", paste("recov", recov_ih)),
                         levels = series_levels))

### Update User
for (l in levels) {
  cat("\nCore", plural[[l]], "by gate, recovery, and prevalence cutoff (blank = recovery above gate)\n")
  core_counts %>%
    filter(level == l) %>%
    select(gate_ih, min_freq, series, n_core) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = series, values_from = n_core, names_sort = TRUE) %>%
    arrange(min_freq, gate_ih) %>%
    print(n = Inf)
}
```

## 5. Plotmaxxing
# Species

## Plot A: Species core size, strict vs recovered

Bars stack strict-only counts with the taxa added by recovery. The number is the total recovered core size. Gates below `plot_recov` have no recovered run, so they show strict only.






## Plot A: Species core size, strict vs recovered

The brown bar is the recovered core and the tan strict-only bar sits over it. The number is the height of the taller bar, which is the recovered core size. Gates below `plot_recov` have no recovered run, so they show strict only.

```{r plot-a, fig.width = 11, fig.height = 4.5}



# recovery threshold for the recovered bars
plot_recov <- 10

# prevalence cutoffs on the x axis
plot_cuts <- c(0.90, 0.95, 0.999)

# totals above this are labeled inside the bar, at or below it above the bar
label_split <- 200

# y-axis limit
y_max <- 400

# colors from RColorBrewer YlOrBr (9 class)
ylorbr <- paletteer_d("RColorBrewer::YlOrBr")

# tan, strict only (#FEE391)
tan <- as.character(ylorbr[3])

# brown, recovered (#993404)
brown <- as.character(ylorbr[8])

### Check: plot_recov was computed
#stopifnot(plot_recov %in% prevalence_grid$recov_ih)

species_bars <- prevalence_grid %>%
  # species rows, strict plus recovered at plot_recov
  filter(level == "species", method == "strict only" | recov_ih == plot_recov) %>%
  # one copy of each row per prevalence cutoff
  crossing(min_freq = plot_cuts) %>%
  # core size for each method x gate x cutoff
  summarize(n_core = sum(freq >= min_freq), .by = c(method, gate_ih, min_freq)) %>%
  # factor order sets drawing order: recovered first, strict drawn over it
  mutate(method = factor(method, levels = c("recovered", "strict only")))

species_labels <- species_bars %>%
  # one label per bar, the height of the taller bar
  summarize(total = max(n_core), .by = c(gate_ih, min_freq))

ggplot(species_bars, aes(x = factor(min_freq), y = n_core, fill = method)) +
  # strict and recovered side by side
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.75) +
  # large counts: label inside the bar, at the bottom
  geom_text(data = filter(species_bars, n_core > label_split),
            aes(x = factor(min_freq), y = 0, label = n_core, group = method),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
            angle = 90, hjust = -0.15, size = 3, color = brown) +
  # small counts: label above the bar
  geom_text(data = filter(species_bars, n_core <= label_split),
            aes(x = factor(min_freq), y = n_core, label = n_core, group = method),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
            angle = 90, hjust = -0.15, size = 3, color = brown) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("strict only" = tan, "recovered" = brown),
                    breaks = c("strict only", "recovered")) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = \(x) paste0(as.numeric(x) * 100, "%")) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, y_max)) +
  facet_wrap(~ gate_ih, nrow = 1,
             labeller = labeller(gate_ih = \(x) paste0("gate ≥ ", x, " intersect hashes"))) +
  labs(x = "Minimum prevalence (% of metagenomes)", y = "Core species", fill = NULL,
       title = "Plot A: Species core size, strict vs recovered",
       subtitle = sprintf("Recovery threshold: %d intersect hashes", plot_recov)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top",
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", color = brown),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())
```


```{r plot-a, fig.width = 11, fig.height = 4.5}
# plot settings
plot_recov  <- 1      # recovery threshold for the "added by recovery" slice
label_split <- 200    # totals above this are labeled inside the bar, at or below it above the bar
y_max       <- 4000   # y-axis limit

### Check: plot_recov was computed
stopifnot(plot_recov %in% recov_cuts)

species_stack <- core_counts %>%
  # species rows, strict plus recovered at the plot recovery threshold
  filter(level == "species", method == "strict only" | recov_ih == plot_recov) %>%
  select(gate_ih, min_freq, method, n_core) %>%
  # one row per gate x cutoff, with strict and recovered counts side by side
  pivot_wider(names_from = method, values_from = n_core) %>%
  # gates below plot_recov have no recovered run, so fall back to strict
  mutate(recovered = coalesce(recovered, `strict only`),
         # the slice recovery adds on top of strict
         `added by recovery` = recovered - `strict only`)

species_stack_long <- species_stack %>%
  # back to long, one row per bar segment, for stacking
  pivot_longer(c(`strict only`, `added by recovery`),
               names_to = "component", values_to = "n") %>%
  # factor order controls stacking: last level sits at the bottom
  mutate(component = factor(component, levels = c("added by recovery", "strict only")))

ggplot(species_stack_long, aes(x = factor(min_freq), y = n, fill = component)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.75) +
  # large totals: label inside the bar, at the bottom
  geom_text(data = filter(species_stack, recovered > label_split),
            aes(x = factor(min_freq), y = 0, label = recovered),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, angle = 90, hjust = -0.15, size = 3, color = "#5C3317") +
  # small totals: label above the bar
  geom_text(data = filter(species_stack, recovered <= label_split),
            aes(x = factor(min_freq), y = recovered, label = recovered),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, angle = 90, hjust = -0.15, size = 3, color = "#5C3317") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("strict only" = "#D2B48C", "added by recovery" = "#A0522D"),
                    breaks = c("strict only", "added by recovery")) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = \(x) paste0(as.numeric(x) * 100, "%")) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, y_max)) +
  facet_wrap(~ gate_ih, nrow = 1,
             labeller = labeller(gate_ih = \(x) paste0("gate ≥ ", x, " intersect hashes"))) +
  labs(x = "Minimum prevalence (% of metagenomes)", y = "Core species", fill = NULL,
       title = "Plot A: Species core size, strict vs recovered",
       subtitle = sprintf("Recovery threshold: %d intersect hashes", plot_recov)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top",
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#5C3317"),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())
```

## Plot B: Species core size by recovery threshold

One line per recovery threshold. The dashed tan line is strict only, for reference.

```{r plot-b, fig.width = 11, fig.height = 4.5}
# plot settings
y_max <- 400   # y-axis limit
# one sienna-to-dark-brown color per recovery threshold, named to match the series column
recov_colors <- setNames(colorRampPalette(c("#C8703F", "#3B1F0E"))(length(recov_cuts)),
                         paste("recov", recov_cuts))

# recovered rows, one line per recovery threshold
species_lines  <- core_counts %>% filter(level == "species", method == "recovered")
# strict rows, drawn as the dashed reference line
species_strict <- core_counts %>% filter(level == "species", method == "strict only")

ggplot(species_lines, aes(x = factor(min_freq), y = n_core, color = series, group = series)) +
  geom_line(data = species_strict,
            aes(x = factor(min_freq), y = n_core, group = 1),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, color = "#D2B48C", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = recov_colors) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = \(x) paste0(as.numeric(x) * 100, "%")) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, y_max)) +
  facet_wrap(~ gate_ih, nrow = 1,
             labeller = labeller(gate_ih = \(x) paste0("gate ≥ ", x, " intersect hashes"))) +
  labs(x = "Minimum prevalence (% of metagenomes)", y = "Core species", color = NULL,
       title = "Plot B: Species core size by recovery threshold",
       subtitle = "Dashed tan line = strict only") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top",
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#5C3317"),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())
```

# Genus

## Plot C: Genus core size, strict vs recovered

```{r plot-c, fig.width = 11, fig.height = 4.5}
# plot settings
plot_recov  <- 1     # recovery threshold for the "added by recovery" slice
label_split <- 200   # totals above this are labeled inside the bar, at or below it above the bar

### Check: plot_recov was computed
stopifnot(plot_recov %in% recov_cuts)

genus_stack <- core_counts %>%
  # genus rows, strict plus recovered at the plot recovery threshold
  filter(level == "genus", method == "strict only" | recov_ih == plot_recov) %>%
  select(gate_ih, min_freq, method, n_core) %>%
  # one row per gate x cutoff, with strict and recovered counts side by side
  pivot_wider(names_from = method, values_from = n_core) %>%
  # gates below plot_recov have no recovered run, so fall back to strict
  mutate(recovered = coalesce(recovered, `strict only`),
         # the slice recovery adds on top of strict
         `added by recovery` = recovered - `strict only`)

genus_stack_long <- genus_stack %>%
  # back to long, one row per bar segment, for stacking
  pivot_longer(c(`strict only`, `added by recovery`),
               names_to = "component", values_to = "n") %>%
  # factor order controls stacking: last level sits at the bottom
  mutate(component = factor(component, levels = c("added by recovery", "strict only")))

ggplot(genus_stack_long, aes(x = factor(min_freq), y = n, fill = component)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.75) +
  # large totals: label inside the bar, at the bottom
  geom_text(data = filter(genus_stack, recovered > label_split),
            aes(x = factor(min_freq), y = 0, label = recovered),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, angle = 90, hjust = -0.15, size = 3, color = "#5C3317") +
  # small totals: label above the bar
  geom_text(data = filter(genus_stack, recovered <= label_split),
            aes(x = factor(min_freq), y = recovered, label = recovered),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, angle = 90, hjust = -0.15, size = 3, color = "#5C3317") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("strict only" = "#D2B48C", "added by recovery" = "#A0522D"),
                    breaks = c("strict only", "added by recovery")) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = \(x) paste0(as.numeric(x) * 100, "%")) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  facet_wrap(~ gate_ih, nrow = 1,
             labeller = labeller(gate_ih = \(x) paste0("gate ≥ ", x, " intersect hashes"))) +
  labs(x = "Minimum prevalence (% of metagenomes)", y = "Core genera", fill = NULL,
       title = "Plot C: Genus core size, strict vs recovered",
       subtitle = sprintf("Recovery threshold: %d intersect hashes", plot_recov)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top",
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#5C3317"),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())
```

## Plot E: Species gained by recovery at a fixed gate

Gate fixed at `plot_gate` intersect hashes. One panel per prevalence cutoff. Each bar is one recovery threshold: tan is the strict-only core, sienna is what recovery adds, and the +N label is that gain. The strict count is in each panel header.

```{r plot-e, fig.width = 11, fig.height = 4.5}
# plot settings
plot_gate <- 50    # gate held fixed across panels
y_max     <- 400   # y-axis limit

### Check: plot_gate was computed
stopifnot(plot_gate %in% gate_cuts)

gate_strict <- core_counts %>%
  # strict-only species core at the plot gate, one row per prevalence cutoff
  filter(level == "species", method == "strict only", gate_ih == plot_gate) %>%
  select(min_freq, strict = n_core)

gate_recov <- core_counts %>%
  # recovered species core at the plot gate, one row per cutoff x recovery threshold
  filter(level == "species", method == "recovered", gate_ih == plot_gate) %>%
  select(min_freq, recov_ih, recovered = n_core) %>%
  # attach the strict count for the same cutoff
  left_join(gate_strict, by = "min_freq") %>%
  # species recovery adds on top of strict
  mutate(added = recovered - strict)

gate_long <- gate_recov %>%
  # long format, one row per bar segment, for stacking
  pivot_longer(c(strict, added), names_to = "component", values_to = "n") %>%
  # factor order controls stacking: last level sits at the bottom
  mutate(component = factor(component, levels = c("added", "strict")))

# panel headers like "95% prevalence / strict = 142", keyed by min_freq
gate_strips <- setNames(paste0(gate_strict$min_freq * 100, "% prevalence\nstrict = ",
                               gate_strict$strict),
                        gate_strict$min_freq)

ggplot(gate_long, aes(x = factor(recov_ih), y = n, fill = component)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  # gain from recovery, above each bar
  geom_text(data = gate_recov,
            aes(x = factor(recov_ih), y = recovered, label = paste0("+", added)),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, vjust = -0.4, size = 3.2,
            fontface = "bold", color = "#A0522D") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("strict" = "#D2B48C", "added" = "#A0522D"),
                    breaks = c("strict", "added"),
                    labels = c("strict only", "added by recovery")) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = \(x) paste("recov", x)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, y_max), clip = "off") +
  facet_wrap(~ min_freq, nrow = 1, labeller = as_labeller(gate_strips)) +
  labs(x = "Recovery threshold (intersect hashes)", y = "Core species", fill = NULL,
       title = sprintf("Plot E: Species gained by recovery at gate %d", plot_gate)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top",
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#5C3317"),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())
```


## Get species names

```{r}
core_strict_20 <- read_csv("intermediate_files/core_prevalence/prevalence_grid.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(level == "species", method == "strict only", gate_ih == 20, freq >= 0.90) %>%
  select(taxon, n_present, freq) %>%
  arrange(desc(freq)) |> 
  select(taxon)

write_csv(core_strict_20, "intermediate_files/core_prevalence/core_species_strict_gate20_freq90.csv")
```
